body:
Build an unattended official Repo2RLEnv PR-to-task workflow with reproducible exports, independent native controls, durable evidence and owned cleanup, without per-task human/LLM repairs.

**Current findings:** installed AnnData/Biopython baselines #53/#57 emitted zero tasks. The declared #58 filter/path candidate reached PR validation, then cleanup removed required built C extensions and both stages failed collection. #60’s eight real compiled-fixture pytest processes distinguish missing extensions from stale binaries and support investigating rebuilding, but no generic rebuild policy is qualified. No accepted fresh task/control pair. [Latest completed native evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0555f803/experiments/58-assertion-regressions/final-summary.json).

**Running:** #62 freezes two previously unrecorded DendroPy PRs with the same installed #58 candidate/model/settings and no new repair or runtime policy. Its original reserved TRC submission is recorded; generation, independent controls and final evidence remain pending. #61’s Cobrapy selection was deferred before execution because its PR already has a recorded export. #56 source provenance and #59 targeting limits remain separate. [Frozen #62 inputs](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4956ab3b/experiments/62-fresh-dendropy/protocol.md).

**Implementation/budget:** Consolidated draft PR #63 now contains the final tested implementation from a fresh main branch: 167 local tests plus lint/types/hooks and both GitHub CI checks pass. PRs #46/#50/#52/#55 remain open/unmerged; main is unchanged. Recorded incremental usage is **$1.635174 / 43 original calls** and **12.208172/32 allocated CPUh**. Current generation reserves 6.333333 CPUh/$13.07; including both possible control lifecycles the additional upper bound is 19 CPUh, projected cumulative31.208172<32. Existing $10 storage reserve remains unreconciled. Same $90 operating ceiling, strictly below $100 extra, reserved CPUs only; reservations are not spend. Detailed logs/accounting in comments.

Keep epic/children/PRs open for review; #28 stays closed. No automatic merge or release. Workflow completion, scientific acceptance and release readiness remain separate.
